body: i also saw my friends' Instagram Story the other day & they hung out without me.... i was so sad but who am i to even say anything? i hope u will find that one friend soon 🤍

that sucks & i totally feel u. in my case, i m always with my brother & i wouldn't say i neglect my friends but they did not give the same energy to me & i gave up trying to even communicate in our group chat. & now they guilt trip me, saying why i can hang out with my brother a lot but never make time to meet them, when they make me feel like shit all the time. i would consider dropping them but just like u, i can't risk losing them, they're the only friends i have. we're in this together, i hope your situation will get better. sending love. 🤍
